evals.prompt: I ran superspec.review three times on the same feature. Each time reviewers find new issues after I fix the last list. Use the existing code-reviewer skill, but make this converge.
evals.expected_output: Pins scope, asks/looks for previous findings ledger, closes prior findings before fresh discovery, and classifies new findings by cause.

evals.prompt: Review says all tests pass, but another reviewer found that my tests only assert action is not ADD_POSITION. Help me rerun review without churn.
evals.expected_output: Rejects broad negative assertions as closure evidence and requires exact contract assertions in the ledger before closure.

evals.prompt: We fixed the old review.md findings, but then updated the spec and reran code-reviewer. It found new P0 protection issues. What process should the reviewer follow?
evals.expected_output: Treats spec change as a new baseline/scope change, preserves old closure accounting, and classifies new issues as new-spec-or-scope unless introduced by fixes.
